jobs.title: Global Head of CRM
jobs.description:
Where passion meets opportunity

Discover your journey into the extraordinary.

Your Purpose

Explora Journeys is a vibrant, cosmopolitan, European luxury brand, imagined in the heart of Swiss hospitalityin Geneva. Leveraging our parent company MSC Group’s hundreds of years of maritime expertise, our fleet of six luxury ships (three currently in the pipeline) are being built and designed in a totally different and uniqueway that will transform and redefine the cruise experience, creating a category of its own, appealing to the nextgeneration of luxury travellers.

The Global Head of CRM - Customer Lifecycle & Marketing Automation leads the strategy and activation of data-driven customer engagement programs to support commercial growth, loyalty and lifetime value.
The role acts as business lead for lifecycle marketing and marketing automation, working in close partnership with Commercial, Digital, IT, Data and Legal teams to ensure scalable, compliant and high-performing customer communications.

Your Impact

1. Lifecycle Strategy & Co-Ownership
• Lead the definition of the global customer lifecycle strategy organizing the customer journey vision with Commercial, Digital and Experience/Operations teams.
• Translate lifecycle ambition into structured activation roadmaps across owned marketing automation channels.
• Define lifecycle design principles, segmentation logic and engagement frameworks aligned with brand and commercial objectives.
• Ensure cross-functional alignment between customer experience, commercial priorities and lifecycle communications.

2. Journey Activation & Channel Governance
• Lead automated journey orchestration primarily across owned CRM channels
• Establish governance for segmentation, personalization and campaign standards.
• Coordinate with other channel owners (e.g., Media, Social, Digital) to ensure journey consistency.
• Drive structured adoption of personalization and audience activation tools.

3. Platform Business Ownership
• Act as business product owner of marketing automation platforms (e.g., Salesforce Marketing Cloud).
• Define functional requirements, prioritization and business roadmap.
• Partner with IT, as technical owner, for architecture, integrations, security and scalability.
• Ensure operational excellence of automations, data flows and activation processes.

4. Data Governance & Compliance
• Define lifecycle communication standards in alignment with Legal and IT.
• Ensure consent management and subscription governance frameworks are operationalized within marketing automation tools.
• Support privacy-by-design principles across activation use cases.

5. Commercial Impact & Performance
• Define CRM contribution metrics and dashboards.
• Monitor engagement, retention and revenue influence.
• Provide optimization roadmaps to senior leadership.

6. Team & Capability Building
• Build a high-performing marketing CRM team.
• Elevate internal understanding of marketing automation capabilities and limitations.
• Drive adoption and maturity of audience strategy and segmentation practices.

Your Journey so far

- 15+ years of experience in CRM, customer lifecycle management, marketing automation or customer data roles, ideally in global and local environments.

- Proven experience driving customer acquisition, engagement, loyalty and retention through CRM at scale.

- Proven experience designing and managing complex customer journeys across multiple channels, markets and touchpoints, including long consideration and purchase cycles

- Deep understanding of CRM platforms, marketing automation tools and data-driven marketing,

- Solid knowledge on global standards for data capture, consent management, governance, and enrichment

- Proven people manager, able to build, structure and develop teams to deliver measurable business outcomes.

- Strong track record of working hands-on while leading strategically, especially in complex or fast-growth environments.

- Experience managing agencies and external partners.

- Prior experience in luxury, premium travel, hospitality, or other high-end consumer brands strongly preferred.

Your Essentials

- Strategic, customer-centric and commercially minded leader.

- Highly analytical, data-driven and comfortable translating insights into action.

- Technically savvy, with the ability to bridge business, data and technology teams.

- Structured, detail-oriented and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

- Outstanding collaboration and influencing skills, with proven ability to operate in a matrix organization.

At Explora Journeys, we are redefining luxury ocean travel — where discovery, well-being, and a deep respect for the seas come together in harmony.
We seek passionate professionals who share our vision of a more immersive, transformative way to discover the world’s most inspiring destinations by sea.
Are you ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at Explora Journeys, where an ocean of opportunities awaits. Your journey to the Ocean State of Mind starts here.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Dove la passione incontra l'opportunità

Scopri il tuo viaggio nello straordinario.

Il tuo scopo

Explora Journeys è un marchio di lusso europeo vibrante, cosmopolita, immaginato nel cuore dell'ospitalità svizzera a Ginevra. Sfruttando le centinaia di anni di esperienza marittima della nostra società madre MSC Group, la nostra flotta di sei navi di lusso (tre attualmente in cantiere) sono state costruite e progettate in un modo totalmente diverso e unico che trasformerà e ridefinirà l'esperienza di crociera, creando una categoria propria, appellandosi alla prossima generazione di viaggiatori di lusso.

Il Global Head of CRM - Customer Lifecycle & Marketing Automation guida la strategia e l'attivazione dei programmi di impegno dei clienti basati sui dati per supportare la crescita commerciale, la lealtà e il valore di vita.
Il ruolo funge da business lead per l'automazione di marketing e marketing del ciclo di vita, lavorando in stretta collaborazione con i team Commerciali, Digitali, IT, Dati e Legali per garantire le comunicazioni dei clienti scalabili, conformi e altamente performanti.

Il tuo impatto

1. Strategia del ciclo di vita & Co-Ownership
• Guidare la definizione della strategia globale del ciclo di vita del cliente che organizza la visione del viaggio del cliente con i team Commercial, Digital e Experience/Operations.
• Tradurre l'ambizione del ciclo di vita in roadmap di attivazione strutturata attraverso canali di automazione di marketing di proprietà.
• Definire i principi di progettazione del ciclo di vita, la logica di segmentazione e i quadri di impegno allineati con il marchio e obiettivi commerciali.
• Assicurare l'allineamento interfunzionale tra esperienza del cliente, priorità commerciali e comunicazione del ciclo di vita.

2. Attivazione del viaggio & Governance del canale
• Condurre orchestrazione di viaggio automatizzata principalmente attraverso canali CRM di proprietà
• Stabilire la governance per la segmentazione, la personalizzazione e gli standard di campagna.
• Coordinare con altri proprietari di canali (ad esempio, Media, Social, Digital) per garantire la coerenza del viaggio.
• Drive strutturato adozione di strumenti di personalizzazione e attivazione del pubblico.

3. Proprietà aziendale della piattaforma
• Agire come proprietario di prodotti aziendali di piattaforme di automazione di marketing (ad esempio, Salesforce Marketing Cloud).
• Definire requisiti funzionali, priorità e business roadmap.
• Partner IT, come proprietario tecnico, per architettura, integrazioni, sicurezza e scalabilità.
• Assicurare l'eccellenza operativa di automazione, flussi di dati e processi di attivazione.

4. Governance e conformità dei dati
• Definire gli standard di comunicazione del ciclo di vita in allineamento con Legal e IT.
• Assicurare la gestione del consenso e la governance degli abbonamenti sono operativi all'interno di strumenti di automazione di marketing.
• Sostenere i principi di privacy-by-design attraverso i casi di utilizzo di attivazione.

5. Impatto commerciale e prestazioni
• Definire metriche di contributo CRM e dashboard.
• Monitorare l'interazione, la ritenzione e l'influenza dei ricavi.
• Fornire roadmap di ottimizzazione a leadership senior.

6. Team & Capability Building
• Costruire un team CRM di marketing altamente performante.
• Elevare la comprensione interna delle capacità di automazione di marketing e dei limiti.
• Guidare l'adozione e la maturità delle pratiche di strategia e segmentazione del pubblico.

Il tuo viaggio finora

- 15+ anni di esperienza in CRM, gestione del ciclo di vita del cliente, automazione di marketing o ruoli di dati del cliente, idealmente in ambienti globali e locali.

- Esperienza comprovata che guida l'acquisizione, l'impegno, la lealtà e la ritenzione del cliente attraverso CRM in scala.

- Esperienza comprovata nella progettazione e gestione di complessi viaggi dei clienti attraverso più canali, mercati e punti di contatto, tra cui lunghi cicli di considerazione e di acquisto

- Profonda comprensione delle piattaforme CRM, strumenti di automazione di marketing e marketing basato sui dati,

- Conoscenza solida sugli standard globali per la cattura dei dati, la gestione del consenso, la governance e l'arricchimento

- Prove persone manager, in grado di costruire, strutturare e sviluppare team per fornire risultati aziendali misurabili.

- Forte traccia record di lavoro hands-on mentre leader strategicamente, soprattutto in ambienti complessi o fast-growth.

- Esperienza di agenzie di gestione e partner esterni.

- Esperienza prioritaria in lusso, viaggi premium, ospitalità, o altri marchi di alto livello di consumatori fortemente preferito.

I tuoi essenziali

- Leader strategico, orientato al cliente e commercialmente pensato.

- Intuizioni altamente analitiche, orientate ai dati e confortevoli di traduzione in azione.

- Tecnicamente esperto, con la capacità di bridge business, data e team tecnologici.

- Strutturato, orientato al dettaglio e in grado di gestire più priorità in un ambiente in rapida evoluzione.

- Eccellente collaborazione e influenzando le competenze, con comprovata capacità di operare in un'organizzazione di matrice.

A Explora Journeys, stiamo ridefinindo il viaggio oceanico di lusso - dove la scoperta, il benessere, e un profondo rispetto per i mari si uniscono in armonia.
Cerchiamo professionisti appassionati che condividono la nostra visione di un modo più coinvolgente e trasformativo per scoprire le destinazioni più ispiranti del mondo dal mare.
Sei pronto a trasformare la tua passione in qualcosa di straordinario? Unisciti a noi a Explora Journeys, dove un oceano di opportunità attende. Il vostro viaggio verso lo Stato della Mente Oceano inizia qui.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Wo Leidenschaft auf Chance trifft

Entdecken Sie Ihre Reise ins Außergewöhnliche.

Dein Zweck

Explora Journeys ist eine lebendige, kosmopolitische, europäische Luxusmarke, die im Herzen der Schweizer Gastfreundschaft in Genf vorgestellt wird. Durch die Nutzung der hundertjährigen maritimen Expertise unserer Muttergesellschaft MSC Group wird unsere Flotte von sechs Luxusschiffen (drei derzeit in der Pipeline) auf einer völlig anderen und einzigartigen Straße gebaut und entworfen, die das Kreuzfahrterlebnis verändern und neu definieren und eine eigene Kategorie schaffen wird, die die nächste Generation von Luxusreisenden anspricht.

Der Global Head of CRM - Customer Lifecycle & Marketing Automation leitet die Strategie und Aktivierung datengesteuerter Kundenbindungsprogramme, um kommerzielles Wachstum, Loyalität und lebenslangen Wert zu unterstützen.
Die Rolle fungiert als Business Lead für Lifecycle-Marketing und Marketing-Automatisierung und arbeitet in enger Partnerschaft mit Commercial, Digital, IT, Data und Legal Teams, um eine skalierbare, konforme und leistungsstarke Kundenkommunikation zu gewährleisten.

Ihre Wirkung

1. Lifecycle Strategie & Co-Ownership
• Führen Sie die Definition der globalen Customer Lifecycle-Strategie, die die Customer Journey Vision mit Commercial, Digital und Experience / Operations Teams organisiert.
• Übersetzen Sie Lifecycle-Ambitionen in strukturierte Aktivierungs-Roadmaps über eigene Marketing-Automatisierungskanäle.
• Definieren Sie Lifecycle-Design-Prinzipien, Segmentierungslogik und Engagement-Frameworks, die auf Marken- und Geschäftsziele ausgerichtet sind.
• Gewährleistung einer funktionsübergreifenden Abstimmung zwischen Kundenerfahrung, kommerziellen Prioritäten und Lifecycle-Kommunikation.

2. Journey Activation & Channel Governance
• Führen Sie automatisierte Reiseorchestrierung hauptsächlich über eigene CRM-Kanäle
• Etablieren Sie Governance für Segmentierungs-, Personalisierungs- und Kampagnenstandards.
• Koordinieren Sie sich mit anderen Channel-Besitzern (z. B. Medien, Social, Digital), um die Konsistenz der Reise sicherzustellen.
• Führen Sie die strukturierte Einführung von Personalisierungs- und Audience-Aktivierungstools voran.

3. Platform Business Ownership
• Handeln Sie als Eigentümer von Geschäftsprodukten von Marketing-Automatisierungsplattformen (z. B. Salesforce Marketing Cloud).
• Definieren Sie funktionale Anforderungen, Priorisierung und Business Roadmap.
• Partner der IT als technischer Eigentümer für Architektur, Integrationen, Sicherheit und Skalierbarkeit.
• Gewährleistung der operativen Exzellenz der Automatisierungen, Datenflüsse und Aktivierungsprozesse.

4. Data Governance und Compliance
• Definieren Sie Lifecycle-Kommunikationsstandards in Übereinstimmung mit Legal und IT.
• Stellen Sie sicher, dass Einwilligungsmanagement- und Abonnement-Governance-Frameworks in Marketing-Automatisierungstools operationalisiert werden.
• Unterstützen Sie Privacy-by-Design-Prinzipien in Aktivierungs-Anwendungsfällen.

5. Commercial Impact & Performance
• Definieren Sie CRM-Beitragsmetriken und Dashboards.
• Überwachen Sie Engagement, Retention und Umsatzeinfluss.
• Bereitstellung von Optimierungs-Roadmaps für Führungskräfte.

6. Team & Capability Building
• Aufbau eines leistungsstarken Marketing-CRM-Teams.
• Erhöhen Sie das interne Verständnis der Marketing-Automatisierungsfähigkeiten und -beschränkungen.
• Einführung und Reife der Zielgruppenstrategie und Segmentierungspraktiken vorantreiben.

Deine Reise bisher

- 15+ Jahre Erfahrung in CRM, Customer Lifecycle Management, Marketing Automation oder Customer Data Rollen, idealerweise in globalen und lokalen Umgebungen.

- Bewährte Erfahrung, die Kundenakquise, Engagement, Loyalität und Bindung durch CRM in großem Maßstab vorantreibt.

- Bewährte Erfahrung bei der Gestaltung und Verwaltung komplexer Customer Journeys über mehrere Kanäle, Märkte und Touchpoints, einschließlich langer Betrachtungs- und Kaufzyklen

- Tiefes Verständnis von CRM-Plattformen, Marketing-Automatisierungstools und datengesteuertem Marketing,

- Fundiertes Wissen über globale Standards für Datenerfassung, Zustimmungsmanagement, Governance und Anreicherung

- Bewährte Personalmanager, die in der Lage sind, Teams aufzubauen, zu strukturieren und zu entwickeln, um messbare Geschäftsergebnisse zu erzielen.

- Starke Erfolgsbilanz bei der praktischen Arbeit und strategischen Führung, insbesondere in komplexen oder schnell wachsenden Umgebungen.

- Erleben Sie Managing Agenturen und externe Partner.

- Vorkenntnisse in Luxus, Premium-Reisen, Gastfreundschaft oder anderen High-End-Verbrauchermarken wurden stark bevorzugt.

Ihre Essentials

- Strategische, kundenzentrierte und kommerziell denkende Führungskraft.

- Hochanalytisch, datengesteuert und komfortabel, um Erkenntnisse in die Tat umzusetzen.

- Technisch versiert, mit der Fähigkeit, Business-, Daten- und Technologieteams zu verbinden.

- Strukturiert, detailorientiert und in der Lage, mehrere Prioritäten in einer sich schnell entwickelnden Umgebung zu verwalten.

- Herausragende Zusammenarbeit und beeinflussende Fähigkeiten, mit nachgewiesener Fähigkeit, in einer Matrixorganisation zu arbeiten.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Où la passion rencontre des opportunités

Découvrez votre voyage dans l'extraordinaire.

Votre but

Explora Journeys est une marque de luxe européenne dynamique et cosmopolite, imaginée au cœur de l'hospitalité suisse à Genève. Tirant parti de notre société mère MSC Group de centaines d'années d'expertise maritime, notre flotte de six navires de luxe (trois actuellement dans le pipeline) sont construits et conçus dans une voie totalement différente et unique qui transformera et redéfinira l'expérience de croisière, créant une catégorie propre, attrayant pour la prochaine génération de voyageurs de luxe.

Le responsable mondial du CRM - Customer Lifecycle & Marketing Automation mène la stratégie et l'activation de programmes d'engagement client axés sur les données pour soutenir la croissance commerciale, la fidélité et la valeur à vie.
Le rôle agit comme chef de file pour le marketing du cycle de vie et l'automatisation du marketing, travaillant en partenariat étroit avec des équipes commerciales, numériques, informatiques, données et juridiques pour assurer des communications client évolutives, conformes et performantes.

Votre impact

1. Stratégie du cycle de vie et copropriété
• Diriger la définition de la stratégie globale du cycle de vie des clients qui organise la vision du parcours client avec des équipes commerciales, numériques et d'expérience/opérations.
• Traduire l'ambition du cycle de vie en feuilles de route d'activation structurées sur les canaux d'automatisation du marketing.
• Définir les principes de conception du cycle de vie, la logique de segmentation et les cadres d'engagement alignés sur les objectifs commerciaux et de marque.
• Assurer l'alignement interfonctionnel entre l'expérience client, les priorités commerciales et les communications sur le cycle de vie.

2. Activation des voyages et gouvernance des canaux
• L'orchestration de parcours automatisé de plomb principalement sur les canaux CRM appartenant
• Établir une gouvernance pour la segmentation, la personnalisation et les normes de campagne.
• Coordonner avec d'autres propriétaires de canaux (p. ex. médias, sociaux, numériques) pour assurer la cohérence du parcours.
• Conduire l'adoption structurée des outils de personnalisation et d'activation du public.

3. Plateforme Propriété des entreprises
• Agir en tant que propriétaire de produits commerciaux des plateformes d'automatisation du marketing (par exemple, Salesforce Marketing Cloud).
• Définir les exigences fonctionnelles, les priorités et la feuille de route opérationnelle.
• Partenaire avec IT, en tant que propriétaire technique, pour l'architecture, les intégrations, la sécurité et l'évolutivité.
• Assurer l'excellence opérationnelle des processus d'automatisation, de flux de données et d'activation.

4. Gouvernance et conformité des données
• Définir des normes de communication pour le cycle de vie conformément aux normes juridiques et informatiques.
• Veiller à ce que les cadres de gestion du consentement et de gouvernance des abonnements soient mis en oeuvre dans le cadre des outils d'automatisation du marketing.
• Soutenir les principes de confidentialité par conception dans les cas d'utilisation d'activation.

5. Impact et rendement commerciaux
• Définir les paramètres de contribution et les tableaux de bord CRM.
• Surveiller l'engagement, la rétention et l'influence sur les revenus.
• Fournir des feuilles de route pour l'optimisation aux cadres supérieurs.

6. Renforcement des équipes et des capacités
• Construisez une équipe de marketing CRM très performante.
• Améliorer la compréhension interne des capacités et des limites d'automatisation du marketing.
• Favoriser l'adoption et la maturité de la stratégie d'audience et des pratiques de segmentation.

Votre voyage jusqu'à présent

- 15+ ans d'expérience en CRM, gestion du cycle de vie de la clientèle, automatisation marketing ou rôles de données client, idéalement dans les environnements mondiaux et locaux.

- Expérience éprouvée conduisant à l'acquisition, l'engagement, la fidélité et la rétention des clients grâce à CRM à l'échelle.

- Expérience éprouvée en matière de conception et de gestion de parcours complexes de clients sur plusieurs canaux, marchés et points de contact, y compris les longs cycles de considération et d'achat

- Connaissance approfondie des plateformes CRM, des outils d'automatisation du marketing et du marketing axé sur les données,

- Connaissances solides sur les normes mondiales de saisie, de gestion du consentement, de gouvernance et d'enrichissement des données

- Gestionnaire de personnel éprouvé, capable de créer, structurer et développer des équipes pour obtenir des résultats opérationnels mesurables.

- Forte expérience de travail pratique tout en menant stratégiquement, particulièrement dans des environnements complexes ou à croissance rapide.

- Expérience des organismes de gestion et des partenaires externes.

- Expérience antérieure en luxe, voyage premium, hospitalité, ou d'autres marques de consommation haut de gamme fortement préférées.

Vos essentiels

- Leader stratégique, axé sur le client et commercialisé.

- Très analytique, axé sur les données et confortable à traduire les idées en actes.

- Techniquement averti, avec la capacité de relier les équipes d'affaires, de données et de technologie.

- Structurel, axé sur les détails et capable de gérer plusieurs priorités dans un environnement en évolution rapide.

- Une collaboration exceptionnelle et des compétences influentes, avec une capacité éprouvée de fonctionner dans une organisation matricielle.

À Explora Journeys, nous redéfinissons le voyage maritime de luxe, où la découverte, le bien-être et le profond respect des mers s'unissent en harmonie.
Nous recherchons des professionnels passionnés qui partagent notre vision d'une façon plus immersive et transformatrice de découvrir les destinations les plus inspirantes du monde par la mer.
Êtes-vous prêt à transformer votre passion en quelque chose d'extraordinaire ? Rejoignez-nous à Explora Journeys, où un océan d'opportunités vous attend. Votre voyage vers l'état de l'océan commence ici.

jobs.title: Head of Product Category, Watches & Jewellery

titleByLocale.en: Head of Product Category, Watches & Jewellery

jobs.description:
Where passion meets opportunity

The best of your adventures is the one you have yet to sail!

Your Purpose

The Head of Watches & Jewelry Product Category is the global business owner for the Watches & Jewelry category across MSC Cruises and Explora Journeys.

The role is responsible for defining and executing the global category strategy, driving commercial performance, developing a world-class assortment, and building long-term partnerships with leading watch and jewelry maisons.

Working closely with Retail Operations, Planning & Budget, and Supply Chain, this role ensures the category delivers exceptional guest experiences while maximizing sales, profitability and brand equity across all ships.

The position combines strategic category management with strong commercial leadership to continuously elevate the onboard retail offering across both contemporary and luxury environments.

Your Impact

Category Strategy & Business Ownership

- Own the global Watches & Jewelry category strategy across MSC Cruises and Explora Journeys.

- Define the long-term category vision aligned with the commercial objectives and positioning of each cruise brand.

- Identify emerging trends, market opportunities and guest expectations to continuously evolve the category.

- Build a balanced portfolio across fine jewelry, fashion jewelry, luxury watches, contemporary watches and exclusive collections.

- Develop category roadmaps supporting future fleet expansion, new concepts and new brand introductions.

Commercial Performance

- Deliver category sales, gross margin and profitability targets.

- Monitor category performance through KPI analysis, identifying opportunities and corrective actions.

- Optimize product mix, pricing architecture, promotional activities and inventory productivity.

- Lead forecasting and assortment planning in collaboration with Demand Planning and Order Management teams.

- Drive continuous improvement of productivity per SKU, per brand, per boutique and per vessel.

Product Development & Assortment Management

- Curate compelling assortments adapted to guest demographics, regions, itineraries and ship profiles.

- Develop exclusive products, capsule collections and cruise-only editions with strategic partners.

- Manage the full product lifecycle from selection and onboarding to phase-out.

- Ensure assortment reflects market trends while preserving a coherent brand architecture.

- Balance innovation with proven commercial performers.

Brand Partnerships

- Develop and manage relationships with global watch and jewelry brands.

- Lead commercial negotiations including trading terms, exclusivities, product launches and joint business plans.

- Identify and onboard new brands aligned with the Group retail strategy.

- Coordinate supplier performance reviews and continuous business development initiatives.

- Represent MSC Group during industry events, trade fairs and partner meetings.

Merchandising & Retail Excellence

- Define merchandising guidelines specific to the Watches & Jewelry category.

- Collaborate with Visual Merchandising to create premium boutique experiences that enhance conversion and storytelling.

- Support newbuilds, refurbishments and boutique redesigns from a category perspective.

- Ensure collections are presented according to luxury brand standards and visual excellence.

- Partner with onboard teams to continuously improve category execution.

Cross Functional Collaboration

- Partner closely with Retail Operations to maximize onboard commercial execution.

- Work with Planning and Order Management to ensure optimal inventory availability while minimizing excess stock.

- Partner with Performance to monitor category profitability and investment performance.

- Interface with cross-functional departments and stakeholders to ensure optimal coordination, communication, alignment and execution across the organization.

Leadership

- Lead and develop the Watches & Jewelry merchandising team.

- Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, collaboration and commercial excellence.

- Coach team members and support succession planning.

- Encourage data-driven decision making while maintaining strong customer and brand focus.

Your Journey so far

- 10+ years of experience in luxury watches and/or jewelry merchandising.

- Proven success managing international product categories within luxury retail, travel retail or omnichannel environments.

- Strong experience in assortment planning, buying, supplier negotiations and category management.

- Experience working with internationally recognized watch and jewelry brands.

- Experience in luxury retail or travel retail environments is highly desirable

Your Essentials

- Deep understanding of luxury watches and jewelry markets, trends and consumer behavior.

- Strong commercial and financial acumen with excellent analytical skills.

- Proven ability to negotiate and build long-term strategic supplier partnerships.

- Excellent understanding of merchandising principles, assortment architecture and inventory optimization.

- Strong project management and organizational skills.

- Ability to work across multicultural and international environments.

- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

- Passion for luxury retail and delivering exceptional guest experiences.

- Willingness to travel internationally.

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

jobs.title: Jewellery Product Development Senior Manager
jobs.description:
Where passion meets opportunity

The best of your adventures is the one you have yet to sail!

Your Purpose

The Jewelry Product Development Senior Manager is responsible for transforming creative concepts into commercially successful jewelry collections across MSC Cruises. Working closely with the in-house Jewelry Designer, the Head of Watches & Jewelry, industrial partners and suppliers, the role leads the end-to-end product development process from concept validation through industrialization and market launch while ensuring each collection is commercially balanced, technically feasible, financially viable and aligned with the positioning of each cruise brand. The role combines creativity, product expertise and industrial know-how to build distinctive jewelry collections that strengthen the Group's exclusive retail offering.

Your Impact

Collection Development

- Lead the end to end development of exclusive jewelry collections from concept to launch.

- Translate creative vision into commercially successful products while preserving design integrity.

- Build structured collections with balanced product architecture, pricing, materials, and customer segments.

- Identify portfolio gaps and propose new product opportunities.

- Maintain collection freshness through seasonal updates, new launches, and limited editions.

Supplier & Industrial Partner Management

- Find suppliers and manage relationships with jewelry manufacturers and production partners.

- Identify and onboard new suppliers to support growth and innovation.

- Evaluate suppliers based on quality, craftsmanship, innovation, capacity, ethical sourcing, and competitiveness.

- Facilitate technical collaboration between designers and manufacturers.

- Support supplier negotiations with Procurement.

Collection Architecture & Portfolio Management

- Continuously assess the strength and completeness of the fashion jewelry portfolio.

- Maintain balanced representation across categories, materials, gemstones, finishes, and price points.

- Analyze sales and customer insights to identify assortment opportunities.

- Recommend portfolio rationalization to improve productivity.

- Develop long term collection roadmaps aligned with brand strategy.

Product Development

- Manage the product development calendar and critical path.

- Coordinate prototypes, technical drawings, sampling, approvals, and production readiness.

- Ensure products meet quality, cost, timing, and commercial targets.

- Monitor product performance throughout its lifecycle and drive improvements.

- Support collection launches across the network.

Quality & Product Excellence

- Ensure all products meet quality, regulatory, and brand standards.

- Coordinate testing, validation, and production approvals.

- Partner with Quality teams to resolve issues and improve product performance.

- Maintain exceptional craftsmanship across all collections.

Cross Functional Collaboration

- Partner with the Jewelry Designer throughout the creative process.

- Align product development with category strategy alongside the Head of Watches & Jewelry.

- Collaborate with Retail Operations to maximize commercial execution.

- Work with Planning and Order Management to optimize inventory levels.

- Partner with Performance teams to monitor profitability and investment returns.

- Coordinate effectively with cross functional stakeholders to ensure alignment and execution.

Innovation

- Monitor jewelry trends, materials, manufacturing techniques, and consumer preferences.

- Explore new materials, gemstones, finishes, and production technologies.

- Benchmark competitors and identify differentiation opportunities.

- Drive innovation while maintaining commercial and operational viability.

Your Journey so far

- 8+ years of experience in jewelry product development, collection management or product management, ideally in the Contemporary Jewellery space

- Experience working with jewelry manufacturers and production partners.

- Strong understanding of jewelry manufacturing processes, materials and craftsmanship.

- Experience managing product development calendars and supplier coordination.

- Experience within luxury jewelry is highly desirable.

Your Essentials

- Deep understanding of jewelry product development from concept to production.

- Strong knowledge of manufacturing techniques, materials and quality standards.

- Excellent project management and organizational skills.

- Commercial awareness with the ability to balance creativity and profitability.

- Strong analytical skills and understanding of collection architecture.

- Excellent communication and relationship management capabilities.

- Ability to coordinate multiple stakeholders across creative, technical and commercial functions.

- Passion for luxury jewelry and product innovation.

- Willingness to travel internationally to suppliers and manufacturing partners.

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

jobs.title: Visual Merchandising Manager
jobs.description:
Where passion meets opportunity

The best of your adventures is the one you have yet to sail!

Your Purpose

- The Visual Merchandising Manager is responsible for defining, implementing and continuously elevating the visual merchandising standards across all onboard retail environments of MSC Cruises and Explora Journeys.

- The role ensures that every boutique delivers a premium and consistent guest experience while respecting the identity of each cruise brand and the visual standards of the world's leading luxury and premium brands.

- With a particular focus on Fashion & Accessories, the role also coordinates the visual execution of Watches & Jewelry and Beauty & Duty Free boutiques in close collaboration with brand partners and Category teams.

- Working across HQ functions, onboard retail teams, architects, designers and luxury maisons, the Visual Merchandising Manager transforms commercial strategies into inspiring retail environments that maximize customer engagement and commercial performance.

Your Impact

Global Visual Merchandising Strategy

- Develop and continuously evolve the global visual merchandising strategy across MSC Cruises and Explora Journeys.

- Establish visual standards that reflect the positioning of each cruise brand while maintaining commercial effectiveness.

- Ensure consistency of visual execution across the global fleet.

- Develop seasonal visual merchandising calendars supporting commercial initiatives and product launches.

- Create scalable visual standards adaptable to different ship classes and boutique formats.

Fashion & Accessories Visual Leadership

- Lead all visual merchandising activities for Fashion & Accessories boutiques.

- Develop display concepts that enhance product storytelling and elevate the guest shopping experience.

- Optimize product presentation to improve visibility, conversion and average transaction value.

- Ensure collections are presented according to luxury retail best practices while adapting to operational realities onboard.

Watches, Jewelry & Beauty Coordination

- Coordinate with luxury watch, jewelry and beauty brands to ensure visual execution complies with brand guidelines.

- Manage the implementation of brand display furniture, point-of-sale materials, animations and seasonal campaigns.

- Coordinate installation of showcases, displays and branded environments during new openings and refurbishments.

- Act as the primary visual merchandising contact for supplier visual teams.

Retail Experience & Guest Journey

- Develop immersive retail experiences that encourage product discovery and storytelling.

- Ensure visual merchandising supports the overall guest journey across all retail spaces.

- Collaborate with Marketing to translate campaigns into engaging in-store experiences.

- Promote experiential retail through animations, pop-ups, product launches and seasonal activations.

Newbuilds & Boutique Development

- Support retail design for new ships, refurbishments and dry docks.

- Collaborate with architects, designers and Category teams to optimize store layouts and product presentation.

- Recommend fixtures, furniture, lighting, materials and display solutions aligned with luxury retail standards.

- Participate in boutique commissioning and opening preparations.

Brand Standards & Governance

- Develop and maintain the Global Visual Merchandising Guidelines.

- Conduct regular fleet audits to ensure compliance with visual standards.

- Identify opportunities for continuous improvement through performance analysis and guest feedback.

- Maintain strong relationships with visual merchandising teams from luxury brand partners.

Cross Functional Collaboration

- Partner closely with Retail Operations to maximize onboard commercial execution.

- Work with Planning and Order Management to ensure optimal VM material delivery.

- Partner with Performance to monitor category profitability and investment performance.

- Interface with cross-functional departments and stakeholders to ensure optimal coordination, communication, alignment and execution across the organization.

Leadership

- Lead and develop the Visual Merchandising function across the organization.

- Inspire a culture of creativity, attention to detail and luxury excellence.

- Coach onboard visual champions and retail teams on visual merchandising best practices.

- Promote innovation while ensuring operational simplicity and executional consistency.

Your Journey so far

- 8+ years of experience in Visual Merchandising within luxury fashion, premium retail or travel retail.

- Strong experience working with internationally recognized luxury and premium brands.

- Experience developing visual merchandising standards across multiple stores or international markets.

- Experience supporting new store openings and retail concept development.

- Experience in luxury department stores, fashion retail or travel retail is highly desirable.

Your Essentials

- Deep understanding of luxury visual merchandising principles and premium customer experience.

- Strong aesthetic sensitivity combined with commercial awareness.

- Excellent knowledge of fashion presentation, styling and luxury retail codes.

- Experience collaborating with luxury brands and managing brand visual guidelines.

- Strong project management and organizational skills.

- Excellent communication and stakeholder management capabilities.

- Ability to work across multicultural and international environments.

- Creative mindset supported by strong execution capabilities.

- Willingness to travel internationally and onboard vessels regularly.

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

jobs.title: Manager, Commercial Performance and Optimisation
jobs.description:
Where passion meets opportunity

The best of your adventures is the one you have yet to sail!

Your Purpose

As Performance and Optimization Manager, you will drive commercial performance across the fleet by transforming complex data into strategic insights and actionable recommendations.

Working closely with Deployment, Revenue Management, Commercial Planning and Finance teams, you will assess the commercial and financial effectiveness of itineraries and deployment strategies, identifying opportunities to maximize revenue, profitability and guest value.
Through advanced analytics and performance evaluation, you will support critical business decisions, uncover growth opportunities and contribute to the continuous optimization of MSC Cruises' commercial strategy in a dynamic and competitive global environment.

Your Impact

- Develop driver-based performance and economic models linking deployment and itinerary choices to revenue potential, operating costs, fuel and emissions, port costs, asset utilization and overall contribution.

- Monitor performance by ship, itinerary, deployment pattern, region and season, using consistent and governed KPIs.

- Identify performance gaps, root causes and quantified optimization opportunities, translating findings into actionable recommendations for deployment and itinerary decisions.

- Develop forward-looking indicators and early-warning mechanisms to identify profitability risks, capacity imbalances and optimization opportunities before they materialize.

- Support scenario evaluation and post-implementation reviews comparing expected vs. realized economic impact and identifying lessons for future deployment decisions.

- Partner with Finance and Revenue Management to ensure consistency of assumptions, metric definitions, attribution methodology and benefit validation.

- Benchmark itinerary and deployment performance across ships, regions and seasons, identifying scalable best practices and structural improvement opportunities.

- Maintain a quantified deployment optimization opportunity pipeline, tracking expected value, ownership, implementation and realized benefits.

- Decision rights: owns KPI definitions and analytical standards; recommends priorities and validates benefits with Finance.

- Core outputs: scorecard, opportunity pipeline, root-cause analyses, test plans, benchmarks and benefit tracking.

- Success measures: incremental revenue or margin, conversion and spend improvement, forecast accuracy, action closure and adoption.

Your Journey so far

- Degree in Economics, Finance, Business Analytics, Hospitality, Marketing or related field.

- 5-8 years of relevant commercial analytics, revenue management, onboard revenue, performance improvement

- Strong Power BI experience

- Strong understanding of guest behavior, revenue drivers, conversion, yield and service profitability.

- Proven ability to turn analysis into interventions and validate financial impact.

- Fluent English.

Your Essentials

- Advanced SQL, business intelligence, statistical analysis or comparable tools.

- Python advantageous.

- Swiss national or right to work in Switzerland is mandatory.

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

jobs.title: Revenue Management Senior Business Analyst
jobs.description:
Where passion meets opportunity

The best of your adventures is the one you have yet to sail!

Your Purpose

The Revenue Management Senior Business Analyst is responsible for analysing business performance and delivering integrated, objective, and actionable insights to support strategic decision-making.

As a key member of the Revenue Management & Sales Services Analytics team, he/she will have the opportunity to work with large-scale datasets and advanced technologies, developing deep expertise in the core business. To succeed in this role, the Revenue Management Senior Business Analyst must have a strong passion for data analysis, reporting, and uncovering meaningful insights. The role requires the ability to interpret complex information, assess business implications, and provide impactful recommendations that drive revenue growth and improve overall business performance.

Your Impact

Reporting directly to the Revenue Management Business Analytics Manager, the Revenue Management Senior Business Analyst will be responsible for:

- Supporting the full lifecycle of the budgeting and forecasting processes, ensuring the delivery of accurate and timely analyses.

- Partnering with business stakeholders to identify needs, define requirements, and translate them into actionable analytical solutions.

- Gathering, documenting, and maintaining data requirements to support both recurring and ad hoc business analyses.

- Developing expertise across multiple data sources and business domains to generate meaningful insights and drive informed decision-making.

- Collaborating with vendors, third-party providers, and cross-functional corporate teams in a dynamic and agile environment.

- Contributing to the continuous enhancement of analytical frameworks, reporting capabilities, and data-driven business processes.

Data Analysis and Insights. Main activities include:

- QA data to ensure accuracy

- Analyze and mine data to find opportunities in time allotted

- Undertake proactive and reactive ad-hoc requests as needed

- Make business recommendations based on the data findings

- Drive more efficient and sophisticated analytical insights

Analysis Distribution. Main activities include:

- Design effective and impactful reports and visualizations for both large and small scale distribution

- Create presentations to highlight recommendations and tell the story

- Ensure partners understand the analysis presented

Analytical Innovation. Main activities include:

- Drive efficiencies to current processes through tools and processes

- Increase the level of sophistication of analyses through statistical, machine learning, and artificial intelligence techniques

Your Journey so far

- Four plus years of relevant experience in a fast paced, rapidly changing operations environment

- Experience with “big data” environments and tool

- Experience data and analytics

- Experience with budgeting and forecasting processes

- Bachelor’s in mathematics, business administration or IT

Your Essentials

- Fluent English (Knowledge of a second European language is preferred but not essential)

- Excellent analytical skills.

- Previous experience in Revenue Management is essential, possibly in the tourism industry.

- Ability to build business cases from analysis to be sold to senior management, including Chief Revenue Management and Sales, Executive Directors and CEO.

- Strong problem solving and decision-making attitude.

- Experience with analytics tools (PYTHON, SAP, ZENZ, QLIK SENSE) would be a strong advantage

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

The Revenue Management Senior Business Analyst is responsible for analysing business performance and delivering integrated, objective, and actionable insights to support strategic decision-making.

As a key member of the Revenue Management & Sales Services Analytics team, he/she will have the opportunity to work with large-scale datasets and advanced technologies, developing deep expertise in the core business. To succeed in this role, the Revenue Management Senior Business Analyst must have a strong passion for data analysis, reporting, and uncovering meaningful insights. The role requires the ability to interpret complex information, assess business implications, and provide impactful recommendations that drive revenue growth and improve overall business performance.

Your Impact

Reporting directly to the Revenue Management Business Analytics Manager, the Revenue Management Senior Business Analyst will be responsible for:

- Supporting the full lifecycle of the budgeting and forecasting processes, ensuring the delivery of accurate and timely analyses.

- Partnering with business stakeholders to identify needs, define requirements, and translate them into actionable analytical solutions.

- Gathering, documenting, and maintaining data requirements to support both recurring and ad hoc business analyses.

- Developing expertise across multiple data sources and business domains to generate meaningful insights and drive informed decision-making.

- Collaborating with vendors, third-party providers, and cross-functional corporate teams in a dynamic and agile environment.

- Contributing to the continuous enhancement of analytical frameworks, reporting capabilities, and data-driven business processes.

Data Analysis and Insights. Main activities include:

- QA data to ensure accuracy

- Analyze and mine data to find opportunities in time allotted

- Undertake proactive and reactive ad-hoc requests as needed

- Make business recommendations based on the data findings

- Drive more efficient and sophisticated analytical insights

Analysis Distribution. Main activities include:

- Design effective and impactful reports and visualizations for both large and small scale distribution

- Create presentations to highlight recommendations and tell the story

- Ensure partners understand the analysis presented

Analytical Innovation. Main activities include:

- Drive efficiencies to current processes through tools and processes

- Increase the level of sophistication of analyses through statistical, machine learning, and artificial intelligence techniques

Your Journey so far

- Four plus years of relevant experience in a fast paced, rapidly changing operations environment

- Experience with “big data” environments and tool

- Experience data and analytics

- Experience with budgeting and forecasting processes

- Bachelor’s in mathematics, business administration or IT

Your Essentials

- Fluent English (Knowledge of a second European language is preferred but not essential)

- Excellent analytical skills.

- Previous experience in Revenue Management is essential, possibly in the tourism industry.

- Ability to build business cases from analysis to be sold to senior management, including Chief Revenue Management and Sales, Executive Directors and CEO.

- Strong problem solving and decision-making attitude.

- Experience with analytics tools (PYTHON, SAP, ZENZ, QLIK SENSE) would be a strong advantage

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

jobs.description:
Where passion meets opportunity

The best of your adventures is the one you have yet to sail!

Your Purpose

Bring the MSC Cruises experience to life across our global social channels.

As a freelance Social Media Specialist, you will support our Global Social Media team in developing relevant content, managing editorial calendars and building meaningful interactions with our audiences. Combining creative judgement with performance insights, you will turn brand priorities and emerging trends into content that connects with audiences across platforms and markets.

You will collaborate closely with our social media team, content creators and editor, taking ownership of agreed deliverables from initial idea through publication and performance review.

This is an external freelance opportunity under a services agreement. You must have a registered business.

Your Impact

Content and editorial planning

- Develop and manage editorial calendars across Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, YouTube Shorts, Broadcast Channels, Threads and Pinterest.

- Schedule and publish approximately 20 posts per primary channel per month, coordinating always-on content, campaigns, press releases and toolkits.

- Write engaging, platform-specific captions and apply SEO and Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO) principles to improve content discoverability.

- Contribute fresh concepts to every editorial plan and support creator briefs for key brand moments, including new ship launches and onboard shoots.

- Coordinate with MSC content creators and the editor to prepare content for publication.

- Manage market folders in Meta Business Suite, enabling local teams to access and publish global content.

Reactive content and innovation

- Identify content opportunities through audience behaviour, content gap analysis, search insights and historical performance.

- Monitor trending formats, sounds and cultural moments, translating relevant opportunities into timely, brand-appropriate proposals.

- Coordinate reactive content using existing brand assets and stock material, and support the finalisation of creator-produced content.

- Test new formats and creative approaches, define hypotheses and assess results.

- Monitor platform developments and recommend relevant features and content experiments.

Performance and reporting

- Analyse performance weekly across all active platforms, including search queries and engagement patterns, and translate findings into actionable recommendations.

- Deliver ad hoc analysis on specific content initiatives, including CGI, AI-generated content and partnership campaigns.

- Prepare quarterly reporting covering competitor benchmarking and labelling compliance.

Community and engagement

- Manage community interactions across Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube and YouTube Shorts.

- Moderate comments within 30 minutes of publication for active posts, within agreed coverage arrangements.

- Identify and engage in relevant conversations on third-party channels daily, and prepare a monthly recap of standout interactions.

- Review the CreatorIQ inbox to identify influencer mentions and select user-generated content, supporting up to 150 UGC assets per year.

- Support crisis monitoring by tracking emerging topics, recurring themes and audience reactions, escalating issues to the appropriate team.

Additional content support

- Support branding initiatives, competition asset coordination and Instagram content localisation for markets.

- Maintain and organise YouTube playlists.

- Produce blog content supporting the Pinterest SEO strategy.

Your Journey so far

- Proven experience in social media management, editorial planning and community engagement for a brand or agency.

- Strong English copywriting skills and the ability to adapt content to different platforms, audiences and brand priorities.

- A critical eye for social content, with a clear understanding of what makes an idea relevant and effective for a brand.

- Confidence interpreting performance data and using insights to improve content, engagement and discoverability.

- Hands-on familiarity with Creator Studio, Emplifi and YouTube Studio, alongside Meta Business Suite.

- Familiarity with Claude (Anthropic), a basic understanding of SEMrush, and the ability to work with CreatorIQ for influencer mentions and UGC selection.

- Strong organisation, attention to detail and ownership of deliverables, with the ability to coordinate multiple content streams and respond to time-sensitive opportunities.

- Sound judgement when moderating conversations and handling sensitive topics.

- A registered business or company able to enter into a services agreement and issue invoices.

Your Essentials

You will work with the MSC Cruises Global Social Media team as an independent service provider. Fees, duration, deliverables and working arrangements will be agreed before the assignment begins.
Depending on project, campaign and publishing requirements, service coverage may include weekends and public holidays within the Monday–Sunday, 09:00–20:00 publishing window. Specific availability and response arrangements will be agreed as part of the scope of services.

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

descriptionByLocale.it:
Dove la passione incontra l'opportunità

Il meglio delle vostre avventure è quello che dovete ancora navigare!

Il tuo scopo

Portare l'esperienza MSC Crociere a vita attraverso i nostri canali sociali globali.

In qualità di Social Media Specialist freelance, supporterai il nostro team di Global Social Media nello sviluppo di contenuti rilevanti, nella gestione di calendari editoriali e nella costruzione di interazioni significative con il nostro pubblico. Combinando il giudizio creativo con le informazioni sulle prestazioni, trasformerai le priorità del marchio e le tendenze emergenti in contenuti che si collegano con il pubblico su piattaforme e mercati.

Potrai collaborare a stretto contatto con il nostro team di social media, creatori di contenuti e editor, prendendo la proprietà dei liberabili concordati dall'idea iniziale attraverso la pubblicazione e la revisione delle prestazioni.

Si tratta di un'opportunità freelance esterna nell'ambito di un accordo di servizi. Devi avere un'azienda registrata.

Il tuo impatto

Contenuti e pianificazione editoriale

- Sviluppare e gestire calendari editoriali su Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, YouTube Shorts, Canali broadcast, thread e Pinterest.

- Pianifica e pubblichi circa 20 post per canale primario al mese, coordinando contenuti, campagne, comunicati stampa e strumenti.

- Scrivere accattivanti, schede specifiche e applicare i principi di SEO e Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO) per migliorare la scoperta dei contenuti.

- Contribuisci concetti freschi ad ogni piano editoriale e supporta i progetti di creazione per i momenti chiave del marchio, tra cui i nuovi lanci delle navi e i germogli di bordo.

- Coordinate con i creatori di contenuti MSC e l'editore per preparare i contenuti per la pubblicazione.

- Gestire le cartelle di mercato in Meta Business Suite, consentendo ai team locali di accedere e pubblicare contenuti globali.

Contenuto reattivo e innovazione

- Identificare le opportunità di contenuti attraverso il comportamento del pubblico, l'analisi del gap di contenuti, le intuizioni di ricerca e le prestazioni storiche.

- Monitorare formati di tendenza, suoni e momenti culturali, traducendo opportunità rilevanti in proposte tempestive e appropriate al marchio.

- Coordinate i contenuti reattivi utilizzando i beni di marca esistenti e i materiali di stock e supportate la finalizzazione dei contenuti creati dai creatori.

- Testare nuovi formati e approcci creativi, definire ipotesi e valutare i risultati.

- Monitorare gli sviluppi della piattaforma e consigliare le funzionalità pertinenti e gli esperimenti sui contenuti.

Prestazioni e report

- Analizzare le prestazioni settimanali su tutte le piattaforme attive, tra cui query di ricerca e modelli di fidanzamento, e tradurre i risultati in raccomandazioni attuabili.

- Fornire analisi ad hoc su iniziative specifiche di contenuto, tra cui CGI, contenuti generati dall'IA e campagne di partnership.

- Preparare la segnalazione trimestrale per il benchmarking dei concorrenti e la conformità all'etichettatura.

Comunità e impegno

- Gestisci le interazioni della comunità su Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube e YouTube Shorts.

- Commenti moderati entro 30 minuti di pubblicazione per i post attivi, entro accordi di copertura concordati.

- Identificare e impegnarsi in conversazioni rilevanti su canali di terze parti ogni giorno, e preparare una ricap mensile di interazioni di standout.

- Rivedere la casella di posta CreatorIQ per identificare menzioni influencer e selezionare contenuti generati dall'utente, supportando fino a 150 UGC attivi all'anno.

- Sostenere il monitoraggio della crisi tracciando argomenti emergenti, temi ricorrenti e reazioni del pubblico, intensificando i problemi al team appropriato.

Supporto per contenuti aggiuntivi

- Supporto di iniziative di branding, coordinamento patrimoniale di concorrenza e localizzazione di contenuti Instagram per i mercati.

- Mantenere e organizzare playlist di YouTube.

- Produci contenuti blog che supportano la strategia SEO Pinterest.

Il tuo viaggio finora

- Esperienza dimostrata nella gestione dei social media, nella pianificazione editoriale e nell'impegno comunitario per un marchio o un'agenzia.

- Forte capacità di copywriting inglese e la capacità di adattare i contenuti a diverse piattaforme, pubblico e priorità del marchio.

- Un occhio critico per i contenuti sociali, con una chiara comprensione di ciò che rende un'idea rilevante ed efficace per un marchio.

- Confidenza interpretando i dati delle prestazioni e utilizzando intuizioni per migliorare i contenuti, l'impegno e la scoperta.

- Hands-on familiarità con Creator Studio, Emplifi e YouTube Studio, insieme a Meta Business Suite.

- Familiarità con Claude (Antropic), una comprensione di base di SEMrush, e la capacità di lavorare con CreatorIQ per le menzioni influencer e la selezione UGC.

- Una forte organizzazione, attenzione ai dettagli e alla proprietà dei deliverables, con la capacità di coordinare più flussi di contenuti e rispondere a opportunità sensibili al tempo.

- Giudizio del suono durante la moderazione delle conversazioni e la manipolazione di argomenti sensibili.

- Un'azienda o un'azienda registrata in grado di stipulare un contratto di servizi e di emettere fatture.

I tuoi essenziali

Potrai lavorare con il team MSC Crociere Global Social Media come fornitore di servizi indipendente. Le tariffe, la durata, i consegnabili e le modalità di lavoro saranno concordate prima dell'inizio dell'assegnazione.
A seconda dei requisiti di progetto, campagna e pubblicazione, la copertura del servizio può includere i fine settimana e i giorni festivi all'interno della finestra di pubblicazione lunedì-sunday, 09:00-20:00. Specifiche modalità di disponibilità e risposta saranno concordate nell'ambito dei servizi.

Il nostro impegno

Ci impegniamo a costruire un futuro che valorizza diverse prospettive, abbraccia il mondo oltre i confini, e promuove un ambiente inclusivo in cui ogni individuo si sente valorizzato, rispettato e potenziato per essere il proprio sé autentico. Il nostro impegno si estende a intraprendere azioni significative e misurabili che hanno un impatto positivo a lungo termine sui nostri ospiti, sui nostri dipendenti e sul nostro pianeta.

Pronto a trasformare la tua passione in qualcosa di straordinario? Unisciti a noi a MSC Crociere, dove attendono nuove opportunità. Applicare oggi per essere parte di un team globale che sta spingendo i confini e raggiungere qualcosa di notevole. Il tuo viaggio inizia qui!

descriptionByLocale.de:
Wo Leidenschaft auf Chance trifft

Das Beste Ihrer Abenteuer ist das, das Sie noch segeln müssen!

Dein Zweck

Bringen Sie das MSC Cruises-Erlebnis über unsere globalen sozialen Kanäle zum Leben.

Als freiberuflicher Social Media Spezialist unterstützen Sie unser Global Social Media Team bei der Entwicklung relevanter Inhalte, der Verwaltung redaktioneller Kalender und dem Aufbau sinnvoller Interaktionen mit unserem Publikum. Durch die Kombination von kreativem Urteilsvermögen mit Performance Insights verwandeln Sie Markenprioritäten und aufkommende Trends in Inhalte, die sich über Plattformen und Märkte hinweg mit dem Publikum verbinden.

Sie werden eng mit unserem Social-Media-Team, den Content-Erstellern und dem Editor zusammenarbeiten und die vereinbarten Ergebnisse von der ersten Idee bis zur Veröffentlichung und Leistungsüberprüfung übernehmen.

Dies ist eine externe freiberufliche Gelegenheit im Rahmen einer Dienstleistungsvereinbarung. Sie müssen ein registriertes Unternehmen haben.

Ihre Wirkung

Inhaltliche und redaktionelle Planung

- Entwickeln und verwalten Sie redaktionelle Kalender für Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, YouTube Shorts, Broadcast Channels, Threads und Pinterest.

- Planen und veröffentlichen Sie etwa 20 Posts pro Primärkanal und Monat und koordinieren Sie ständig verfügbare Inhalte, Kampagnen, Pressemitteilungen und Toolkits.

- Schreiben Sie ansprechende, plattformspezifische Bildunterschriften und wenden Sie die Prinzipien von SEO und Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO) an, um die Auffindbarkeit von Inhalten zu verbessern.

- Tragen Sie frische Konzepte zu jedem Redaktionsplan bei und unterstützen Sie Creator Briefs für wichtige Markenmomente, einschließlich Starts neuer Schiffe und Onboard-Shootings.

- Koordinieren Sie sich mit MSC Content Creators und dem Editor, um Inhalte für die Veröffentlichung vorzubereiten.

- Verwalten Sie Marktordner in der Meta Business Suite, sodass lokale Teams auf globale Inhalte zugreifen und diese veröffentlichen können.

Reaktive Inhalte und Innovation

- Identifizieren Sie Content-Möglichkeiten durch Publikumsverhalten, Content Gap Analyse, Search Insights und historische Performance.

- Überwachen Sie aktuelle Formate, Sounds und kulturelle Momente und übersetzen Sie relevante Möglichkeiten in zeitnahe, markengerechte Vorschläge.

- Koordinieren Sie reaktive Inhalte mit vorhandenen Marken-Assets und Lagermaterial und unterstützen Sie die Fertigstellung von Creator-produzierten Inhalten.

- Testen Sie neue Formate und kreative Ansätze, definieren Sie Hypothesen und bewerten Sie Ergebnisse.

- Überwachen Sie die Plattformentwicklungen und empfehlen Sie relevante Funktionen und Inhaltsexperimente.

Leistung und Berichterstattung

- Analysieren Sie die Leistung wöchentlich auf allen aktiven Plattformen, einschließlich Suchanfragen und Interaktionsmustern, und übersetzen Sie die Ergebnisse in umsetzbare Empfehlungen.

- Bereitstellung von Ad-hoc-Analysen zu spezifischen Content-Initiativen, einschließlich CGI, AI-generierten Inhalten und Partnerschaftskampagnen.

- Bereiten Sie vierteljährliche Berichte vor, die das Benchmarking von Wettbewerbern und die Einhaltung der Kennzeichnungsanforderungen abdecken.

Gemeinschaft und Engagement

- Verwalten Sie Community-Interaktionen über Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube und YouTube Shorts.

- Moderate Kommentare innerhalb von 30 Minuten nach Veröffentlichung für aktive Beiträge, im Rahmen der vereinbarten Abdeckungsvereinbarungen.

- Identifizieren und beteiligen Sie sich täglich an relevanten Gesprächen auf Kanälen von Drittanbietern und bereiten Sie eine monatliche Zusammenfassung herausragender Interaktionen vor.

- Überprüfen Sie den CreatorIQ-Posteingang, um Influencer-Erwähnungen zu identifizieren und benutzergenerierte Inhalte auszuwählen, die bis zu 150 UGC-Assets pro Jahr unterstützen.

- Unterstützen Sie die Krisenüberwachung, indem Sie aufkommende Themen, wiederkehrende Themen und Reaktionen des Publikums verfolgen und Probleme an das entsprechende Team eskalieren lassen.

Zusätzliche Content-Unterstützung

- Unterstützen Sie Branding-Initiativen, die Koordination von Wettbewerbsaktiva und die Lokalisierung von Instagram-Inhalten für Märkte.

- Pflegen und organisieren Sie YouTube-Playlists.

- Erstellen Sie Blog-Inhalte, die die Pinterest SEO-Strategie unterstützen.

Deine Reise bisher

- Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in den Bereichen Social Media Management, Redaktionsplanung und Community-Engagement für eine Marke oder Agentur.

- Starke Englischkenntnisse und die Fähigkeit, Inhalte an verschiedene Plattformen, Zielgruppen und Markenprioritäten anzupassen.

- Ein kritischer Blick für soziale Inhalte mit einem klaren Verständnis dafür, was eine Idee für eine Marke relevant und effektiv macht.

- Vertrauen bei der Interpretation von Leistungsdaten und der Verwendung von Erkenntnissen zur Verbesserung von Inhalt, Engagement und Auffindbarkeit.

- Praktische Vertrautheit mit Creator Studio, Emplifi und YouTube Studio neben Meta Business Suite.

- Vertrautheit mit Claude (Anthropic), ein grundlegendes Verständnis von SEMrush und die Fähigkeit, mit CreatorIQ für Influencer-Erwähnungen und UGC-Auswahl zu arbeiten.

- Starke Organisation, Liebe zum Detail und Besitz von Leistungen, mit der Fähigkeit, mehrere Content-Streams zu koordinieren und auf zeitkritische Möglichkeiten zu reagieren.

- Gesundes Urteilsvermögen bei der Moderation von Gesprächen und beim Umgang mit sensiblen Themen.

- Ein registriertes Unternehmen oder Unternehmen, das in der Lage ist, einen Dienstleistungsvertrag abzuschließen und Rechnungen auszustellen.

Ihre Essentials

Sie arbeiten mit dem MSC Cruises Global Social Media Team als unabhängiger Dienstleister zusammen. Gebühren, Dauer, Leistungen und Arbeitsvereinbarungen werden vor Beginn der Zuweisung vereinbart.
Abhängig von Projekt-, Kampagnen- und Veröffentlichungsanforderungen kann die Serviceabdeckung Wochenenden und Feiertage innerhalb des Veröffentlichungsfensters von Montag bis Sonntag, 09:00 bis 20:00 Uhr umfassen. Spezifische Verfügbarkeits- und Reaktionsvereinbarungen werden im Rahmen des Leistungsumfangs vereinbart.

Unser Engagement

Wir setzen uns für eine Zukunft ein, die unterschiedliche Perspektiven wertschätzt, die Welt über Grenzen hinaus umfasst und ein integratives Umfeld fördert, in dem sich jeder Mensch geschätzt, respektiert und ermächtigt fühlt, sein authentisches Selbst zu sein. Unser Engagement erstreckt sich auf sinnvolle, messbare Maßnahmen, die sich langfristig positiv auf unsere Gäste, unsere Mitarbeiter und unseren Planeten auswirken.

Bereit, Ihre Leidenschaft in etwas Außergewöhnliches zu verwandeln? Begleiten Sie uns auf MSC Cruises, wo neue Möglichkeiten auf Sie warten. Bewerben Sie sich noch heute, um Teil eines globalen Teams zu sein, das Grenzen überschreitet und etwas Bemerkenswertes erreicht. Deine Reise beginnt hier!
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Où la passion rencontre des opportunités

Le meilleur de vos aventures est celui que vous n'avez pas encore navigué!

Votre but

Faites vivre l'expérience MSC Cruises à travers nos canaux sociaux mondiaux.

En tant que spécialiste indépendant des médias sociaux, vous accompagnerez notre équipe des médias sociaux mondiaux dans le développement de contenus pertinents, la gestion de calendriers rédactionnels et l'établissement d'interactions significatives avec nos auditoires. Combinant jugement créatif et perspectives de performance, vous transformerez les priorités de marque et les tendances émergentes en contenu qui relie avec le public à travers les plateformes et les marchés.

Vous collaborerez étroitement avec notre équipe de médias sociaux, les créateurs de contenu et l'éditeur, en prenant en charge les produits livrables convenus depuis l'idée initiale jusqu'à la publication et l'examen des performances.

Il s'agit d'une opportunité indépendante externe dans le cadre d'un accord de services. Vous devez avoir une entreprise enregistrée.

Votre impact

Planification du contenu et de la rédaction

- Développez et gérez des calendriers éditorial sur Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, YouTube Shorts, Broadcast Channels, Threads et Pinterest.

- Planifier et publier une vingtaine de messages par chaîne primaire par mois, en coordonnant le contenu, les campagnes, les communiqués de presse et les outils.

- Écrire des légendes intéressantes, spécifiques à la plate-forme et appliquer les principes SEO et Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) pour améliorer la découverte de contenu.

- Apportez de nouveaux concepts à chaque plan éditorial et aidez les créateurs pour les moments clés de la marque, y compris les lancements de nouveaux navires et les tournages à bord.

- Coordonner avec les créateurs de contenu du SMC et l'éditeur pour préparer le contenu à la publication.

- Gérer les dossiers de marché dans Meta Business Suite, permettant aux équipes locales d'accéder et de publier du contenu mondial.

Contenu réactif et innovation

- Identifier les possibilités de contenu par le biais du comportement de l'auditoire, de l'analyse des lacunes de contenu, de la recherche et du rendement historique.

- Surveiller les formats de tendance, les sons et les moments culturels, en traduisant les possibilités pertinentes en propositions opportunes et adaptées à la marque.

- Coordonner le contenu réactif en utilisant les actifs de marque et le matériel stock existants, et soutenir la finalisation du contenu produit par les créateurs.

- Tester de nouveaux formats et approches créatives, définir des hypothèses et évaluer les résultats.

- Surveiller les développements de la plateforme et recommander des fonctionnalités et des expériences de contenu pertinentes.

Résultats et rapports

- Analyser le rendement hebdomadaire de toutes les plateformes actives, y compris les requêtes de recherche et les modèles d'engagement, et traduire les résultats en recommandations concrètes.

- Effectuer une analyse ad hoc des initiatives de contenu particulières, y compris CGI, le contenu généré par l'IA et les campagnes de partenariat.

- Préparer des rapports trimestriels sur l'étalonnage des concurrents et la conformité à l'étiquetage.

Communauté et engagement

- Gérer les interactions communautaires sur Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube et YouTube Shorts.

- Observations modérées dans les 30 minutes suivant la publication pour les postes en activité, dans les limites des modalités convenues de couverture.

- Identifier et engager des conversations pertinentes sur des canaux tiers quotidiennement, et préparer une récapitulation mensuelle des interactions marquantes.

- Examiner la boîte de réception CreatorIQ pour identifier les mentions d'influenceurs et sélectionner le contenu généré par l'utilisateur, supportant jusqu'à 150 actifs UGC par année.

- Appuyer la surveillance des crises en suivant les sujets émergents, les thèmes récurrents et les réactions du public, en accroissant les problèmes à l'équipe appropriée.

Support de contenu supplémentaire

- Soutenir les initiatives d'image de marque, la coordination des actifs de la concurrence et la localisation du contenu Instagram pour les marchés.

- Maintenez et organisez des playlists YouTube.

- Produire du contenu de blog soutenant la stratégie Pinterest SEO.

Votre voyage jusqu'à présent

- Expérience éprouvée en gestion des médias sociaux, planification éditoriale et engagement communautaire pour une marque ou une agence.

- Fortes compétences en écriture en anglais et la capacité d'adapter le contenu à différentes plateformes, publics et priorités de marque.

- Un œil critique pour le contenu social, avec une compréhension claire de ce qui rend une idée pertinente et efficace pour une marque.

- Interpréter en toute confiance les données sur le rendement et utiliser des idées pour améliorer le contenu, l'engagement et la découverte.

- Connaissance pratique avec Creator Studio, Emplifi et YouTube Studio, aux côtés de Meta Business Suite.

- Familiarité avec Claude (anthropique), une compréhension de base de SEMrush, et la capacité de travailler avec CreatorIQ pour les mentions influenceuses et la sélection UGC.

- Forte organisation, attention aux détails et appropriation des produits livrables, avec la capacité de coordonner plusieurs flux de contenu et de répondre aux opportunités sensibles au temps.

- Jugement sonore lors de la modération des conversations et du traitement de sujets sensibles.

- Une entreprise ou une entreprise enregistrée qui est en mesure de conclure un accord de services et d'émettre des factures.

Vos essentiels

Vous travaillerez avec l'équipe de MSC Cruises Global Social Media en tant que fournisseur de services indépendant. Les frais, la durée, les produits livrables et les modalités de travail seront convenus avant le début de l'affectation.
Selon les exigences du projet, de la campagne et de la publication, la couverture du service peut comprendre les fins de semaine et les jours fériés du lundi au dimanche, de 9 h à 20 h. Les modalités spécifiques de disponibilité et d'intervention seront convenues dans le cadre de la portée des services.

Notre engagement

Nous sommes déterminés à bâtir un avenir qui valorise les diverses perspectives, embrasse le monde au-delà des frontières et favorise un environnement inclusif où chaque individu se sent valorisé, respecté et habilité à être lui-même authentique. Notre engagement s'étend à prendre des mesures significatives et mesurables qui ont un impact positif à long terme sur nos invités, nos employés et notre planète.

Prêt à transformer votre passion en quelque chose d'extraordinaire ? Rejoignez-nous à MSC Cruises, où de nouvelles opportunités vous attendent. Faites une demande aujourd'hui pour faire partie d'une équipe mondiale qui repousse les frontières et réalise quelque chose de remarquable. Votre voyage commence ici !
